name: Brutal Follow Through (Combat)
body:
When you land a decisive blow, you know how to make it count.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): Whenever you score a critical hit with a weapon while using the Power Attack feat, you also deal additional damage as though your attack was a sneak attack. If the attack would qualify as a sneak attack, instead you add 2d6 to your sneak attack damage.
